observations: Black electric motorcycle with a large battery pack under the seat.
Rear suspension fork with a white rear fender.
Front handlebars with mirrors and a black seat.
The image is a photo taken indoors or in a covered area, not outdoors on a street.
A watermark 'Jiji' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: Photos of the bike outside in natural daylight.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used with potential for rust or damage

risks.risk: The battery capacity and health are unknown; it may be near the end of its lifespan.
risks.proof: A video showing a video of the bike running on battery power alone.

risks.risk: The motor may be faulty or have a high failure rate.
risks.proof: A video of the bike starting and running without external power.

proof_requests: Photos of the bike outside in daylight to check for rust and tire condition.
A video of the bike running on battery power alone.
A photo of the manufacturer's label on the battery or motor to confirm the model and capacity.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
